counter_identity_evidence: Existing numeric counter rule retained with explicit official_vendor level and CSP guide citation.

implemented_runtime_fields.name: browser-info
implemented_runtime_fields.description: Nonempty browser-info gates the optional runtime defaults. It is a profile hint, not proof of producer identity, a closed flag grammar or a required noscript field.

implemented_runtime_fields.name: page-url
implemented_runtime_fields.description: Pinned prepareUrl uses String.slice with a 2048 UTF-16-unit cap, or 512 on IE. The broad 2048 cap uses exact code-unit counting but cannot enforce the lower IE cap without browser context. Custom schemes and empty values remain open.

implemented_runtime_fields.name: charset
implemented_runtime_fields.description: Optional default-producer advice: senderWatchInfo emits utf-8. This does not establish receiver-wide encoding law, field requiredness or restrictions on custom middleware.

implemented_runtime_fields.name: site-info
implemented_runtime_fields.description: Optional serialized JSON visit parameters can arrive in URL or form fallback fields. All JSON root types and arbitrary custom members remain open. Blank, macro and cross-carrier ambiguity follow existing input behavior.

json_decoder: Existing encoded-body JsonDocument reader. Generic serde_json scalar JSON format is intentionally not used because JS lone-surrogate escapes are valid source output.

unimplemented_or_external_requirements: Runtime defaults are optional source-profile advice, not complete receiver law. browser-info is only a nonempty gate, not proof of SDK identity. Counter-only noscript requests remain outside runtime checks.
The page-url cap counts UTF-16 units exactly; 2048 is a conservative common cap across unknown browser contexts. The tighter512-unit IE branch requires browser context.
All JSON roots, custom members, lone-surrogate escapes and native nonfinite-to-null coercions remain open; no business schema is inferred.

Existing form fallback gives URL carriers precedence. Cross-carrier body fields shadowed by URL names are not independently inspected; receiver duplicate selection is unknown. Duplicates within the selected carrier remain checked.
Legacy bare URL keys are omitted and empty encoded sources skipped. Macro-looking invalid JSON is deferred by the existing shared reader.
Site-info may be deferred to a later request, form-encoded, or moved into URL by image/JSONP/beacon. No mandatory body, method, MIME or beacon-only flag law is inferred.
Browser-info flags/title parsing, current deployment equivalence, other Metrica hosts, collect/Measurement Protocol and user/session/account truth remain outside this change.
